snippet.title: Valor Mortis | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
On October 13, charge into a supernatural retelling of the Napoleonic Wars in Valor Mortis, a first-person Soulslike by the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army, wield supernatural powers, and battle horrifying historical monsters. 

Wishlist Now!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828710/Valor_Mortis/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016571
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/valor-mortis/9p861v1542bl

Coming to Steam, PS5, and XBOX, and day one with XBOX Game Pass.

Discord https://discord.com/invite/valormortis
Twitter https://x.com/ValorMortis
